limitations: Survey estimates and Census reported/adjusted statistics are separate series; neither is an error-free direct count.
Suppressed, unavailable and precision-limited source cells remain nonnumeric; (Z) and (Y) are not converted to zero.
Coverage varies by place, commodity, source program and year. Census observations are actual report years, not interpolated annual estimates.
Overlapping classes, practices, units and total/component products must not be added as independent output.

COUNTY source combined/other geographies remain in the ledger but are excluded from model eligibility; exact historical county FIPS without current outlines remain measurements with mapping missingness.
Map boundaries do not reconstruct historical counties. No name/proximity join or current-boundary back-allocation is made.
Native YEAR can be a crop/reporting-year or season-ending label. Current and forward annual figures may be forecasts or preliminary; revisions remain publisher snapshots.

For covered row crops, NASS introduced model-based county estimates for crop year2020, combining administrative/survey information and benchmarking to state estimates; no local method-break harmonization is performed.

series.hosted_scope_note: Hosted subset: all retained records with native five-digit county identifiers beginning 51 (Virginia) or 19 (Iowa). Other counties remain in the full retained research dataset and original USDA downloads.
